title: Right / left 11-11 (rules)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones). This experiment uses simple rules: a rest/active state machine to find events and a single-threshold rule to tell R from L, as the baseline other methods must beat. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: One-threshold rule 'R if pitch_max >= 51' gets 16/19 in leave-one-out; the rule from experiment 02 gets 11/19 (does not transfer)
method: State machine for detection + one-threshold rule (OneR) for R/L, tested with leave-one-out; also tests the rule from experiment 02
